events.description: 6. ORDER THAT UNITE 4 FREEDOM, INC. SHALL INSTRUCT ITS COUNSEL TO FILE AN ENTRY OF APPEARANCE ON ITS BEHALF WITHIN THIRTY (30) DAYS OF THE DATE OF THIS ORDER. IF UNITE 4 FREEDOM SEEKS TO PROCEED WITH THIS CASE, IT MUST, WITHIN THIRTY (30) DAYS OF THE DATE OF THIS ORDER, PAY $405 (THE $350 FILING FEE AND $55 ADMINISTRATIVE FEE) TO THE CLERK OF COURT. UNITE 4 FREEDOM, INC. MAY NOT PROCEED IN FORMA PAUPERIS, BECAUSE ONLY A NATURAL PERSON MAY QUALIFY FOR TREATMENT IN FORMA PAUPERIS UNDER § 1915.. IF ANY OF THE PLAINTIFFS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THIS ORDER, THEIR CLAIMS MAY BE DISMISSED WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE FOR FAILURE TO PROSECUTE; ETC.. SIGNED BY DISTRICT JUDGE JUAN R. SANCHEZ ON 11/4/26. (Attachments: # 1 IFP FORM) 11/4/26 ENTERED AND E-MAILED ALONG WITH IFP FORM.(JL) (Entered: 11/04/2026)
